purpose: Fast local knowledge index for Ask POLY website assistant.
rules: Do not invent lesson pages or notes PDFs.
If View Lessons is missing, the local lesson file is not uploaded yet.
If Download Notes is missing, the local notes PDF is not uploaded yet.
Use SITTTR syllabus and sample question paper links for official references.
For broken links, ask for page URL, subject code, button name, screenshot and what happened.

pages.title: Home
pages.summary: Homepage contains Quick Subject Finder for Revision 2021 subjects, main navigation, Ask POLY floating link, important day card, and shortcuts to Revision 2021, Mock Exams, Materials and Tools.

pages.title: Revision 2021 Departments
pages.summary: Lists all Revision 2021 diploma departments. Each department opens the stable department viewer with semester-wise subject cards.

pages.title: Revision 2021 Department Viewer
pages.summary: Shows Semester 1 to Semester 6 subject cards for a selected department. Subject cards may include Open Syllabus, Sample QP, View Lessons and Download Notes. Lesson and Notes buttons appear only when local files are available.

pages.title: Mock Exams
pages.summary: Mock Exams page is used for quiz and exam practice. Students can use it for revision and checking understanding.

pages.title: 2015 Materials
pages.summary: Contains study material links for the older 2015 scheme. This is separate from Revision 2021.

pages.title: Student Tools
pages.summary: Tools page contains calculators, converters, academic helpers and engineering-related tools. Ask POLY is also available as a website guide tool.

pages.title: Ask POLY
pages.summary: Ask POLY is the website assistant. It helps with subjects, syllabus links, available lessons, notes, mock exams, materials, tools and issue reporting.

pages.title: Help and Corrections
pages.summary: Use Help page to report missing content, wrong links, syllabus mistakes, broken buttons, or request corrections. Send page URL, subject code, screenshot and issue details.

faq.question: Why is View Lessons missing?
faq.answer: View Lessons is shown only when the local lesson HTML file exists for that subject code. If missing, the lesson is not uploaded yet.

faq.question: Why is Download Notes missing?
faq.answer: Download Notes is shown only when the local PDF notes file exists for that subject code. If missing, the notes PDF is not uploaded yet.

faq.question: Where do I find syllabus?
faq.answer: Open the subject card and click Open Syllabus. It opens the official SITTTR syllabus page for that subject code.

faq.question: Where do I find sample question paper?
faq.answer: Open the subject card and click Sample QP. It opens the official SITTTR model question paper page for that subject code.

faq.question: How do I report a broken link?
faq.answer: Open Help page and send the page URL, subject code, button or link name, screenshot, and what happened.

faq.question: Does Ask POLY know all uploaded notes?
faq.answer: Ask POLY knows the current availability list of uploaded lesson and notes files. Full PDF paragraph-level retrieval requires a later backend vector index.
